title: vaultengine JSON-RPC 2.0 API
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio: one UTF-8 JSON message per line, in both directions. Params are by-name objects. The root schema accepts a single message or a batch.

index.build.summary: Create or incrementally update the index.

index.status.summary: Whether the index exists and is up to date.

vault.stats.summary: Summary numbers for the indexed vault.

notes.pick.summary: Fuzzy-find notes by title and alias.

note.get.summary: Properties, tags, headings, blocks and links in/out of one note.

search.query.summary: Search with text and structure; ranked hits with snippets, tag and folder counts.

note.preview.summary: A note's lines with a query's matches marked.

note.related.summary: Notes related to a note by links, text and tags, each with a reason.

links.suggest.summary: Pairs of notes that probably belong linked, with the evidence.

notes.suggest.summary: Missing notes worth writing, overlapping names, links meant for existing notes.

mentions.unlinked.summary: Plain-text mentions of note titles and aliases that are not links yet.

clause.description: The clause as written in the query, e.g. reward, "reward hacking", a NEAR/3 b.
clause.title: Clause

term.description: For a word: the indexed word that matched (a close spelling when not exact).
term.title: Term

tags.description: Tags of all matching notes; a nested tag also counts for its parents.
tags.title: Tags

folders.description: Folders of all matching notes, every ancestor; "" is the vault root.
folders.title: Folders

count.description: Occurrences (for a phrase or NEAR pair: its matches).
count.title: Count

limit.description: Max items per category (null = all). Summary counts are never limited.
limit.title: Limit

HealthReportRequest.description: Link and structure problems. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
HealthReportRequest.title: HealthReportRequest

orphans.description: Notes no other note links to.
orphans.title: Orphans

dead_ends.description: Notes with no resolved links to another note.
dead_ends.title: Dead Ends

full.description: Re-parse every note and re-resolve every link.
full.title: Full

IndexBuildRequest.description: Create or incrementally update the index. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
IndexBuildRequest.title: IndexBuildRequest

forced.description: Unchanged notes re-parsed because of a full run.
forced.title: Forced

links_changed_elsewhere.description: Of those, links in notes not re-parsed whose result changed.
links_changed_elsewhere.title: Links Changed Elsewhere

IndexStatusRequest.description: Whether the index exists and is up to date. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
IndexStatusRequest.title: IndexStatusRequest

stale.description: True if index.build would change anything; null if not built.
stale.title: Stale

path.description: Only pairs whose paths both contain this text.
path.title: Path

LinksSuggestRequest.description: Pairs of notes that probably belong linked, with the evidence. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
LinksSuggestRequest.title: LinksSuggestRequest

links.description: Never a pair that is already linked, or a note with itself.
links.title: Links

start.description: Offset of the first marked character in the text it belongs to.
start.title: Start

kind.description: fuzzy: a close spelling of a query word.
kind.title: Kind

note.description: Only mentions of this note; omit for every note.
note.title: Note

min_words.description: Ignore titles and aliases shorter than this many words.
min_words.title: Min Words

limit.description: Mentioned notes returned (null = all); totals are never limited.
limit.title: Limit

MentionsUnlinkedRequest.description: Plain-text mentions of note titles and aliases that are not links yet. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
MentionsUnlinkedRequest.title: MentionsUnlinkedRequest

notes.description: Notes with at least one unlinked mention.
notes.title: Notes

mentions.description: Other notes that contain the name without linking it.
mentions.title: Mentions

NoteGetRequest.description: Properties, tags, headings, blocks and links in/out of one note. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteGetRequest.title: NoteGetRequest

links_in.description: Resolved links from other notes (self-links excluded).
links_in.title: Links In

query.description: Mark this query's matches, as search.query counts them.
query.title: Query

NotePreviewRequest.description: A note's lines with a query's matches marked. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NotePreviewRequest.title: NotePreviewRequest

matched.description: Whether the note matches the query at all.
matched.title: Matched

marks.description: Marked spans in the whole note.
marks.title: Marks

lines.description: Every line of the file; matches marked in the body and headings.
lines.title: Lines

note.description: Note name, path or alias as in a link, or the target of links to a missing note.
note.title: Note

unlinked.description: Only notes with no link to or from the note.
unlinked.title: Unlinked

NoteRelatedRequest.description: Notes related to a note by links, text and tags, each with a reason. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NoteRelatedRequest.title: NoteRelatedRequest

query.description: Space-separated tokens, each matched as a subsequence.
query.title: Query

NotesPickRequest.description: Fuzzy-find notes by title and alias. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NotesPickRequest.title: NotesPickRequest

total.description: Matching notes before the limit was applied.
total.title: Total

min_links.description: Only missing notes linked from at least this many notes.
min_links.title: Min Links

NotesSuggestRequest.description: Missing notes worth writing, overlapping names, links meant for existing notes. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
NotesSuggestRequest.title: NotesSuggestRequest

same_idea.description: Overlapping names: the same idea twice, or a topic and a narrower one.
same_idea.title: Same Idea

target.description: As written; empty for same-note links.
target.title: Target

reason.description: Set when a version or setting change forces a rebuild.
reason.title: Reason

positions.description: Indexes of matched characters in matched_text.
positions.title: Positions

reason.description: E.g. "2 hops via kl-penalty-in-rlhf · shares #rl · similar text (kl, ppo)".
reason.title: Reason

path.description: null for a missing note (a link target without a note).
path.title: Path

linkers.description: For a missing note: the notes that link to it.
linkers.title: Linkers

Response.description: Any response this server sends: a method result or an error.

variants.description: Close spellings found in the index.
variants.title: Variants

exact.description: Words, phrases and NEAR pairs matched exactly; the first sort key.
exact.title: Exact

matches.description: Empty when the note matched only the filters.
matches.title: Matches

query.description: The query language of `vault search` (README: "Search and queries"). A syntax error is error -32003, with data.start/data.end (offsets in the query) and data.hint.
query.title: Query

limit.description: Hits returned; total counts all matches.
limit.title: Limit

facets.description: Rows of tag and folder counts (0 = all).
facets.title: Facets

SearchQueryRequest.description: Search with text and structure; ranked hits with snippets, tag and folder counts. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
SearchQueryRequest.title: SearchQueryRequest

tree.description: The parsed query as an s-expression.
tree.title: Tree

clauses.description: Words, phrases and NEAR pairs that rank (not negated).
clauses.title: Clauses

source.description: The note with the mention; it does not link to the target.
source.title: Source

start.description: Offset in the source note's text.
start.title: Start

VaultStatsRequest.description: Summary numbers for the indexed vault. Omit "id" to send a notification (no response).
VaultStatsRequest.title: VaultStatsRequest

most_wanted.description: Unresolved targets by number of linking notes.
most_wanted.title: Most Wanted
